text.text_excerpt: I enjoyed my stay at the Le Méridien, the location is super accessible to the French Quarter and also close to good places for shopping and restaurants. Harrah's casino being across the street was a win too! My check in process was quick and painless (major shout to Lahrain who was super nice!). I was able to even get my room without waiting since I landed earlier than the check in time. Kevin assisted with my luggage and I must give him a shout out as well as he was super nice and provided some great recommendations on where to visit and what to eat. I was on the 8th floor which provided an ok view but I would've like to be a tad higher if I could. The room was clean and nice and provide...

We just spent four nights at this hotel and everything about our stay here was pleasant. It was our first time visiting New Orleans and I wanted to stay at a hotel that was centrally located and within walking distance to the spots we wanted to explore. Le Méridien provided all that and then some. When we arrived in our rental car, I knew ahead of time that valet with in/out access was going to be a steep $42 dollars/day, but oh well. We were on vacation and I'm not going to hem and haw over the cost of that and try to find cheaper parking at a spot I'm not familiar with. Heads up on that if you're planning a visit here and you have a car in tow. Help yourself to the complimentary, mini b...

I guess this depends on how much you have to pay; we really enjoyed the outstanding location next to the casino, near the waterfront and the French Quarter. We were able to walk almost anywhere we wanted to. The hotel itself is quite comfortable and is well kept. I am an SPG member, and I heard a quip by a guest saying they should become an SPG member. I guess I got some extra perks but I don't know what, except for a late check-out option which I needed. The bed is comfortable and we experienced no problems during out 3 night stay. We also took advantage of the refrigerator. The room was good-sized and the view was nice. I was overall very happy with our accommodations!
